title: Great little laptop
body: Seller Verified Purchase I've not bought a computer since 2010 so I was very interested to see how things had moved on since then. This laptop is small and light but still pleasantly large enough. It was easy to set up by following the onscreen instructions. It loads really quickly too! You can set up log in via password or face recognition. The screen is bright and colourful. The keyboard keys are large but securely imbedded. Microsoft Office software is included but it is basic. There is also co pilot ai which helps with searches, constructing emails and other documents. It came fully charged and I've only had to charge it once so far which was quite quick, 20-85% in 30 minutes. I have found it very different from previous Windows operating systems. Rather than programs there are apps which have taken some getting use to. More like a crossover of mobile devices and traditional computers. I did struggle to set up my gmail/outlook (more tricky) email accounts but managed to find a way around it so I can access them both. My one disappointment was that there was only one USB A port. Luckily, I already had a USB A hub I could use. Overall, I've been really impressed so far. Still lots more to explore on it when I get the time. - ![Image 1 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-945b/k2-_d069a068-8d4c-4648-8898-1818d3a5f3c2.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) - ![Image 2 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-de69/k2-_9f0fac0e-ad36-4422-bb85-bd3a32961692.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) - ![Image 3 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-cfb3/k2-_2d6f5e9c-28f9-4d7c-85dd-cf47dc8606e5.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) International review Review from **hp.com** Helpful?(0) (0) 2NZJ6X42NLM517688270243 reply from **HP Customer Experience** What a massive leap forward from 2010! 💙 It’s brilliant your first new computer in a decade is making such an impression with its "instant-on" speed and facial recognition. We’re thrilled the Snapdragon® X efficiency and fast charging are providing that modern convenience we aimed for. It’s great you’re already finding Copilot helpful for emails! We understand the new app layout takes some getting used to, but it sounds like you’re already a pro. ---

title: Good for students and home users
body: Nice little laptop which is going to be used for homework and admin rather than anything heavy, although it probably could handle gaming. It was so easy to set up and is quite intuitive. Everything runs pretty quickly and the keyboard keys have a good feel to them. It's lightweight and great for portability. The display is perfect and the sound clear. It has two usb/c ports and one regular usb, as well as a headphone jack. It charges quickly via usb/c and it holds its battery well (although I'm using it for activities that don't require much power so can't comment on battery life with gaming). My only one gripe is that I find the touch pad not as sensitive as what I am used to so I will probably get a mouse for it. Overall 4 stars. - ![Image 1 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-7f4f/k2-_8cda0a9b-e04e-4915-9abe-ac69ce87932d.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) International review Review from **influenster.com** Helpful?(0) (0) 2NZJ6X42NLM517688270243 reply from **HP Customer Experience** Happy to hear the OmniBook 5 is making light work of your admin and homework! 💙 We hear you on the touchpad sensitivity- everyone has a different preference when it comes to "feel," so grabbing a mouse sounds like a cracking idea to make your setup even more comfortable.
